title: Meta's free cash flow plunges 91% as AI investment grows
excerpt: Meta's AI investments cut free cash flow by 91%, while ad revenue rose 27% as AI boosts ad targeting and content recommendations.
content_html:
Meta’s AI bets are swallowing almost all its free cash flow

By Pranav Dixit

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

The infrastructure behind Meta's AI-powered advertising machine is swallowing almost every dollar of cash the company produces.

Meta said on its Wednesday earnings call that its free cash flow — the money left from operating cash after capital investments — plunged 91% from a year ago to $784 million in the second quarter of 2026. Its free cash flow exceeded $12 billion last quarter.

The collapse wasn't because Meta's business stopped delivering. Net cash from operating activities rose 25% year-over-year to $31.86 billion. Meanwhile, capital expenditures on servers, data centers, and networking — which all power Meta's AI systems — surged 83% to $31.08 billion, nearly wiping out its free cash flow.

The company said that AI is improving how it recommends content and matches ads with users, helping advertising revenue climb 27%. In other words, parts of Meta's AI investment already deliver returns.

The spending follows a period when Meta was seen as falling behind OpenAI and Google in the race to build leading models. CEO Mark Zuckerberg responded by overhauling its AI operation under Meta Superintelligence Labs in 2025.

In April, the lab released Muse Spark, a new model that powers Meta AI and can understand text, images, and other inputs. It has since released Muse Spark 1.1 and an image-generation model, Muse Image.

Meta is also spending on a more distant future: larger models, personal agents, business tools, and a possible enterprise computing business. The company expects capital expenditures of up to $145 billion this year.

"There is a lead time where we're investing in building out these data centers now," Zuckerberg said.

Meta is "not getting value out of them until they're online," he added.

Susan Li, Meta's chief financial officer, said the company's "strong operating cash flow" left it in a "position of strength" to fund the infrastructure buildout, even as little remained after capital spending.

Big Tech giants are collectively pouring over $700 billion into AI infrastructure this year. While Google's free cash flow turned negative for the first time in decades earlier this month, Microsoft's shares jumped after it held its spending plan steady on Wednesday.

Meta's stock, meanwhile, fell nearly 10% in after-hours trading following its results.

Clearly, Wall Street is rewarding restraint.

Meta 的人工智能押注几乎吞噬了其所有自由现金流

作者：Pranav Dixit 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

Meta 的人工智能广告机背后的基础设施正在吞噬该公司生产的几乎每一美元现金。

Meta 在周三的财报电话会议上表示，其自由现金流（资本投资后运营现金剩余的资金）在 2026 年第二季度同比下降 91% 至 7.84 亿美元。 上季度其自由现金流超过 120 亿美元。

崩溃并不是因为 Meta 的业务停止交付。 经营活动产生的现金净额同比增长 25%，达到 318.6 亿美元。 与此同时，服务器、数据中心和网络（所有这些都为 Meta 的人工智能系统提供动力）的资本支出激增 83%，达到 310.8 亿美元，几乎耗尽了其自由现金流。

该公司表示，人工智能正在改进推荐内容以及将广告与用户匹配的方式，帮助广告收入增长 27%。 换句话说，Meta 的部分人工智能投资已经带来了回报。

在这笔支出之前，Meta 被认为在构建领先模型的竞赛中落后于 OpenAI 和谷歌。 作为回应，首席执行官马克·扎克伯格将于 2025 年在 Meta Superintelligence Labs 下彻底改革其人工智能业务。

今年 4 月，该实验室发布了 Muse Spark，这是一种为 Meta AI 提供支持的新模型，可以理解文本、图像和其他输入。 此后，它发布了 Muse Spark 1.1 和图像生成模型 Muse Image。

Meta 还投资于更遥远的未来：更大的模型、个人代理、商业工具以及可能的企业计算业务。 该公司预计今年的资本支出将高达 1450 亿美元。

扎克伯格表示：“我们现在投资建设这些数据中心还有一个准备时间。”

他补充说，Meta“在他们上线之前无法从他们身上获取价值”。

Meta首席财务官苏珊·李(Susan Li)表示，该公司“强劲的运营现金流”使其处于“有实力”为基础设施建设提供资金，尽管资本支出后所剩无几。

今年，大型科技巨头总共向人工智能基础设施投入了超过 7000 亿美元。 尽管本月早些时候谷歌的自由现金流数十年来首次变为负数，但微软周三维持支出计划稳定后股价大幅上涨。

与此同时，Meta 的股价在公布业绩后的盘后交易中下跌了近 10%。

显然，华尔街正在奖励克制。
